messages:
isaac-eng: Hey team \ planning to stay in Rome for ~6 weeks (2026-04-05 -> 2026-05-17) at my partner's apartment. Quick Qs: 1) Is WFH stipend prorated for 6w abroad? 2) Do I need to file a Temporary Location vs change homebase? 3) Any Italian payroll/tax red flags for ~45 days? 4) I'll carry my company MacBook and leave a personal iPad there \ any import issues? :it:

mira-peopleops: Short answers: stipend = prorated by calendar days for temp moves under 90 days; submit the Temporary Location form (do not change homebase unless permanent). That triggers payroll & legal checks.

zara-legal: Tagging in: Italy follows 183-day residency but also has concept of "habitual abode." 45 days is normally safe for tax residency but be mindful if you meet customers or do paid work locally. Do not sign any local contracts. If you plan to host meetups or customer calls in person, flag it on the form.

kevin-payroll: Payroll notes: confirm stipend currency (USD/EUR). Stipend processed through payroll and taxed per your home-country setup; we generally do not gross-up for short temporary stays. If you leave your personal iPad in-country that is your risk; company covers company-owned devices only.

it-bot: Shipping/device checklist: register company device serial with IT before travel, enable FileVault, bring YubiKey, avoid public Wi-Fi without VPN. If you need shipops to move company gear, use shipops@redwood.com for export docs and insured transit (company covers up to $2k per device).

mira-peopleops: Please attach dates, full address, device serials, stipend currency preference, and manager approval to the Temporary Location form. Well open a case for payroll/legal review.

ticket-bot: HR case created: HR-13021 "Temporary remote: Rome 2026-04-05 to 2026-05-17 (Isaac)". Assigned to people-ops/mira.

isaac-eng: Thanks everyone \ I'll file the form now and mark stipend in EUR. No customer meetings planned, just family time. Will CC my manager and attach device serial. Appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:
